cohort: 41,427 women aged 12-55 years undergoing childbirth between June 2014 and May 2019 in 84 hospitals in a statewide quality collaborative
finding: Significant variation in postpartum opioid prescribing was observed across providers and hospitals, with higher rates and larger prescription sizes for cesarean births compared to vaginal births.
mod_finding: Opioid prescription rates and sizes were significantly higher after cesarean birth compared to vaginal birth.
